headline: EPS climbs sequentially, edges up year-over-year
summary_short: Berkshire Hathaway reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of $6.03, up 5.1% y/y from $5.73.
summary_long: Basic EPS of $6.03 rose 5.1% year-over-year from $5.73, and was up 28.6% sequentially from $4.68 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
